name: How do I choose the right contractor for a kitchen addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a kitchen addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a general contractor who provides hands-on oversight, coordinates specialty sub-trades, and excels at detailed interior finishes. Because kitchen additions require structural framing alongside fine carpentry, drywall, and custom tile installation, working with an owner-operated contractor ensures direct accountability from foundation to final paint. Check that they carry proper licensing, maintain an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau, and offer clear communication regarding change orders and work schedules. Reviewing examples of their framing, tile, and trim work confirms their craft quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, experienced contractor with strong finish carpentry and tile skills, direct on-site management, and verified credentials like a BBB accreditation.
